scope: Two independent eight-input paired recursive roots, one persistent worker process per GPU, CPU-audited independently.
timing_scope: Fleet execution includes worker launch, fixture copies, preprocessing, proving and independent CPU audits; excludes prior wallet-proof creation and binary builds.
limitations: One concurrent window followed by one sequential window; no randomized repetitions or statistical confidence interval.
Hybrid proving binaries from the existing verified Linux path; GPU-only development is independent and was not changed.
Shared desktop GPUs; normal compositor activity remained active and device utilization includes that activity.
Both modes reserve two identical worker slots; each worker uses eight CPU threads and at most 18 GiB charged RAM.
This measures aggregation of existing wallet proofs, not fresh wallet creation, accepted-chain throughput or production readiness.

interrupted_attempt.failure: RuntimeError: Another GPU worker started; stopping this screen to release the devices
